businesses.business: Household, personal care and specialty products

offering_description.value: Makes household cleaning, laundry, personal care and consumer health products for sale through retailers and online. It also supplies sodium bicarbonate and other specialty ingredients to industrial, food and animal nutrition customers.

primary_products.value: laundry detergents and household cleaners; oral and skin care products; condoms and pregnancy tests; baking soda and industrial bicarbonates; animal feed additives

customer_segment.value: B2B: Mass merchants, grocery and drug chains, online retailers, distributors, industrial and food manufacturers, and feed producers; B2C: Shoppers buying household, personal care and consumer health products through company websites

end_markets.value: household cleaning and laundry; personal care and consumer health; food and baking; animal nutrition; industrial processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged household and personal care goods, consumer health products, and bulk specialty ingredients

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes raw materials into packaged consumer goods and specialty ingredients for retailers, distributors and commercial customers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Mexico, Europe, Australia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Household and personal care goods, consumer health products, industrial and food ingredients, and animal nutrition additives

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Mass merchants, supermarkets, drugstores, warehouse clubs and other retailers; online: Third-party e-commerce retailers and company-operated brand websites; distributors / dealers: Wholesale distributors for consumer goods and specialty ingredients; direct sales: National retail accounts and industrial, food and animal nutrition customers
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; online; distributors / dealers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA clearance for products such as condoms and pregnancy tests, plus FDA rules for food and feed ingredients

notes: The current scope of some smaller consumer product lines is uncertain.
